title: Agent payments startup raises $210M in a synergy-driven round
summary: The company says its checkout agents now serve 3,400 merchants and settle payments in 9 seconds.

title: Shared memory store cuts agent hosting costs by 38%
summary: A team moved long-term agent memory into one vector store and reported a 38% drop in monthly hosting costs across 14 production agents.

title: Browser agents fill web forms with 82% accuracy in a public test
summary: A public benchmark of 1,200 web forms found browser agents completed 82% without human help.

title: Audit finds prompt injection in 1 of 6 agent tool outputs
summary: Researchers reviewed 600 tool outputs from deployed agents and found injected instructions in 1 of every 6.

title: Parallel tool calls cut agent task time by 41%
summary: A new SDK release runs independent tool calls in parallel, which cut median task time by 41% in the vendor's tests of 300 tasks.

title: Voice agent latency drops to 480 ms
summary: A speech stack update brought end-to-end voice agent latency down to 480 ms on a standard call.

title: Tracing spec adds a schema for agent tool spans
summary: The draft spec defines 11 attributes for recording agent tool calls so traces from different frameworks line up.

title: Forum thread on memory leaks in long agent runs
summary: Developers in a forum thread report memory growth after 72 hours of continuous agent runs, with no official response yet.

title: Coding agents open 22% of merged pull requests at one company
summary: One engineering team says coding agents authored 22% of the pull requests it merged last month.

title: Vendors move agents to per-task pricing
summary: Three vendors announced per-task pricing for hosted agents, replacing per-seat plans.

title: Open eval suite for agents ships with 500 tasks
summary: The suite has 500 tasks across coding, research and support work, and scores each run on completion and cost.

title: Orchestrator pattern splits research across 5 sub-agents
summary: A case study describes one lead agent handing reading to 5 sub-agents and merging their notes.

title: Strict tool schemas end malformed tool arguments in tests
summary: Turning on strict schemas removed malformed tool arguments across 2,000 test calls, according to the release notes.

title: Browser agent launch is a game-changer, says vendor
summary: The vendor claims its browser agent books travel end to end and has 1.5 million waitlist sign-ups.

title: Agent frameworks turn on sandboxing by default
summary: Two frameworks now run agent shell commands in a sandbox unless the developer opts out.

title: Memory compaction keeps agent context under 50,000 tokens
summary: A summarizing memory layer kept agent context under 50,000 tokens during week-long tasks.

title: Voice agents hand calls to humans in under 2 seconds
summary: A contact-center vendor says its voice agents now transfer to a human in under 2 seconds.

title: Coding agents now write tests first in a new workflow
summary: A team reports its coding agents write failing tests before code, and 64% of their patches pass review on the first try.

title: Cost dashboards break down agent spend per tool
summary: New dashboards attribute agent spend to individual tools, so teams can see which tool calls cost the most.

title: Agent platforms trim free tiers
summary: Two agent platforms cut free-tier task limits by half this week.

title: Agent evals start tracking cost per completed task
summary: A benchmark update reports cost per completed task alongside accuracy, and the cheapest top-10 agent spent $0.42 per task.

title: Handoffs between agents drop context in 1 of 4 runs
summary: A study of 400 multi-agent runs found context lost at a handoff in 1 of every 4.

title: Revolutionary retry layer makes agents 5x more reliable
summary: The vendor says automatic retries made its agents 5x more reliable across 10,000 runs.

title: Browser agents stop at CAPTCHAs and ask for help
summary: A browser agent release now pauses at CAPTCHAs and hands control back to the user.

title: Agent logs leak API keys in 3% of sampled traces
summary: A scan of 5,000 agent traces found API keys written to logs in 3% of them.

title: Tool search lets agents load tools on demand
summary: Agents can now search a catalog of 1,000 tools and load only the ones a task needs.

title: Teams leverage coding agents for migrations
summary: Teams report using coding agents to move 40 services to a new logging library.

title: Memory privacy controls let users delete what agents remember
summary: A new setting lets users see and delete the facts an agent has stored about them.

title: Voice agents improve on regional accents
summary: An update cut word errors on regional accents by 18% in the vendor's tests.

title: Replay debugging comes to agent traces
summary: Developers can now replay a recorded agent run step by step from its trace.
